game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 2: {'width': 3, 'height': 4}; {'width': 5, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about spell_ok to power up the volcanologist and open the fire shrine.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
